A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the strong coupling series of the two-point Green functions of the O(N) lattice sigma model with N>=3 on a square, triangular and honeycomb latters are analyzed, focusing the evaluation of dimension-less renormalization-group invariant ratios of physical quantities.

the two-dimensional O(N)sigma models with N>=3 on the square, triangular, or honeycomb lattics are asymptotically free and have the same critical behavior, which is described by the same universality class.
the two-point functions of asymptoticaly free O(N) lattice models on square, triangular and honeycomb lattiices are very close to each other, and to the large N solution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the strong-coupling expansion of the O(N) sigma model on a square lattice is a very accurate method for the determination of universal quantities.
lattice field theory is a viable tool for studying the strong coupling limit of QCD, at least in the quenched approximation.
, at least in the two-dimensional case, the strong-coupling expansion is an extremely efficient tool in determining the critical behavior of asymptotically-free theories.
